instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, test the window latch. Push the frame, please; looking at it tells us nothing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't move. Goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One moment. The curtain is moving. We haven't isolated the draught.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the fan. The window's fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Switch the fan off and repeat the test. Same pressure, please. We can't compare results if you rush this one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One last cup before your taxi. Dry inside the handle, please; that's where water stays.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. My taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just put it on the shelf. Handle inward; we don't leave breakables over the edge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling. I have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask him to confirm the destination, not just his arrival. Put him on speaker, please; I'll check he has the postcode.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your spill soaked my sock. I've laid it beside your plate so we can assess the damage properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That identifies the liquid, not the inconvenience. Please compare it with my dry sock before dismissing the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I understand. Can you take them off the dinner table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An acknowledgement is not an apology. Say you're sorry and I'll clear both samples. Then we can eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've marked the buses I missed on this timetable while you had my keys. Read the times from left to right, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You waited twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Waiting time and consequences are separate measures. Three buses here; cold dinner here. Please don't put the receipt on top of the timetable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy you another dinner. Can we clear the table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's compensation, not an apology. Say you're sorry for keeping the keys and I'll clear the evidence before the replacement dinner arrives.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say yes to the garden-party date before the hold expires. We secure the venue before we design the event.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests are you planning?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's capacity planning, a later stage. Please don't begin with chairs when we haven't confirmed a garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't agree without seeing the price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll open the quote. You confirm the date while it loads. In that order, please; reading isn't a reservation.

beats.text: Just approve the sofa delivery. We complete the handover before discussing installation.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name is on bathroom duty, not mine. Take the mop by the handle, please; you're dripping on the clean floor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You do it better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then follow my instructions. Start at the far corner, not the doorway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Show me the first bit and I'll carry on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Move your hands apart on the handle. Your hands, please. I can demonstrate perfectly well without taking it off you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I covered your bins while you were away. Cover is temporary; tonight you take them out. Lid closed, handles facing the road.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbours send all the reminders to you now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then correct the contact list. Tell them you're responsible; don't just add your name beneath mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in the group until I learn which bin goes when?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read me tonight's colour from the calendar. Then send 'I'll put that one out.' I'll check the colour before I leave, not put the bin out after.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For Mum's dinner invitations, give me the confirmed time, not an estimate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven. You made the booking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the venue exactly as printed. Consistency matters when people are finding a restaurant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't remember the restaurant, do you? It's in the confirmation on your phone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then read it aloud. I'll check the spelling as you go. We verify against the source, please, not somebody's memory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brief me on tomorrow's hike. Route first, then meeting point; muddled instructions are how people get lost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're taking the ridge because the river path flooded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've given the reason. Now give the exact meeting point, so nobody has to wander about looking for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told you twice. Have you forgotten your own itinerary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I am testing your briefing, not asking for directions. Begin with the meeting point this time. I'll stop you when you've supplied enough detail.
